title: Best Web Banner Designers (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a web banner designer for display ads and website banners: sizes, file limits, briefing, price factors and red flags.
intro: Web banners appear as display ads on other sites and as promotional banners on your own site. They must grab attention in a small space, load quickly and meet ad network size and file limits. Banner sets go wrong when sizes are missing, files are too heavy, or text is unreadable at small sizes. This guide helps you order a complete, working set.

faq.q: Which banner sizes do I need?
faq.a: It depends on the ad network or website. Display networks accept many standard sizes; ask your ad manager or check the network's list and share it with the designer.
Yes. Ad networks limit file size and sometimes animation length. Share the limits before design starts so banners are not rejected.
Animation can attract attention, but it adds file size and may be limited by the network. A clear static banner often performs just as well.
Ask for source files or templates, so you can update offers and dates without a new order.
